name: destination_release
description: One destination's standing for one source's material, in the lifecycle declared by schemas/control/destination-release.cue. Readiness and delivery are different facts and this record keeps them apart: a state is a delivery only when the compiled lifecycle says that state delivers, and only a receipt naming what was materialized puts it there. A row here is never a reuse licence, never the destination agreeing the material is correct, and never authority to publish anything to anyone.
